name: Legal marketing and intake hiring demand: pay, headcount and openings (Bureau of Labor Statistics)
description: What the roles around a law firm's growth work pay and how many people hold them, and how hiring is moving. Annual pay bands and headcounts (10th, 25th, median, 75th and 90th percentile and mean annual wage) for marketing managers, marketing and market-research specialists, public relations specialists, writers, web designers, web developers, receptionists and customer service representatives from the Bureau of Labor Statistics' Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS): nationally within legal services, nationally across all industries, and in every state and DC. Monthly series add legal services employment and average hourly earnings, job openings, hires and quits in professional and business services, and each state's average job-openings and hires rates over the latest year for all nonfarm employers. Aggregates only: no firm, job posting or person.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Legal marketing and intake hiring demand: pay, headcount and openings (Bureau of Labor Statistics) (Version 1.0.2) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24116041

distribution.name: legal-hiring-demand.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: legal-hiring-demand.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: legal-hiring-demand-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in legal-hiring-demand-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to legal-hiring-demand.csv on id.

recordSet.name: legal-hiring-demand
recordSet.description: The records of Legal marketing and intake hiring demand: pay, headcount and openings (Bureau of Labor Statistics), one per CSV row.

field.name: stateName
field.description: State name (United States on national records)

field.name: kind
field.description: pay (annual role pay and headcount), month (a national monthly series) or state-demand (a state's job-openings and hires rates)

field.name: scope
field.description: legal-services or all-industries for pay records; national-monthly or state-monthly for the monthly records

field.name: seriesId
field.description: The statistics bureau's series id behind the record (for pay records, the median annual wage series)

field.name: status
field.description: P: the figure as published by the bureau

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: The headline figure: median annual wage (pay), the month's value (month) or the average job-openings rate over the latest year (state-demand)

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
